versions.changelog:
Initial release of pinduoduo-deal-finder

- Discover historical low prices, flash sales, and coupon deals on Pinduoduo.
- Monitor "Billion Yuan Subsidy" items for real-time price and stock changes.
- Track multi-person group deals and free item bargaining progress.
- Compare prices with Taobao/JD.com and find hidden discount coupons.
- Demo queries and result templates included for easy use.
- Free and paid usage plans detailed.
